public_rationale: The records establish losses at a prominent developer, but that does not establish a majority. The wording leaves both the developer population and profitability measure unspecified. Reports of cash burn cannot substitute for comparable profits and losses. The evidence is insufficient to support or contradict the population-wide claim.
limitations: The selected financial interval is an evaluator interpretation.
A startup-only population could produce a different result from one including diversified developers.
No complete financial census was found.

statement.excerpt: Modest profits was maybe a bit optimistic, with most LLM developers losing money.
statement.document_title: Could China devastate the US without firing a shot?

our_interpretation: Most means more than half of developers by company count, not by revenue or funding.
The ordinary reading is that developers are unprofitable after expenses. Cash consumption alone does not establish this.
Use the first half of 2025 as the latest comparable financial reporting interval available before publication for the private developers discussed in context.
The population must include a defensible set of LLM developers rather than a selection of prominent loss-making startups. The wording does not specify an accounting basis.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable profit-and-loss results establish that more than half of a defensibly defined developer population lost money during the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable results establish that half or fewer of that population lost money during the target period.
